title: MBII FA Creator Enums Index
description: Index of mechanically derived enum catalogs under the recorded mb_defines.h source-default configuration. Catalogs include sentinel/count markers; enum membership does not establish parser acceptance, gameplay mechanics, or compiled/deployed feature availability.

attributes.description: Source-default MBAttribute_t declaration: active ordered numeric values and selectable identifiers

weapons.description: Source-default weapon_t declaration, including inactive-gate exclusion and count markers

force_powers.description: Source-default forcePowers_t declaration; separate from special-action EAS_FP_* identifiers

saber_styles.description: Source-default saber_styles_t declaration; parser availability is a separate contract

holdables.description: Source-default holdable_t and gEntityActionSkill_t declarations in separate holdables and extended_abilities domains

powerups.description: Source-default powerup_t declaration, including the count marker

class_flags.description: Source-default siegeClassFlags_t and siegeWeaponFlags_t enum bit indices, not scalar masks

classes.description: Source-default classes_t declaration: active ordered numeric values and selectable identifiers
